pd_disc_pdr.definition: entry below the 50% of the prior day's full-session range (long) / above (short)

near_eq_pdr.definition: entry within 10% of the prior-day range around its 50% (equilibrium)

pd_disc_day.definition: entry below the 50% of today's range so far (session from 18:00)

pd_disc_h1.definition: entry below the 50% of the 1H dealing range (last confirmed 1H swing high / low)

pd_disc_week.definition: entry below the 50% of the prior week's range

ote_5m.definition: entry at a 62-79% retracement of the last 5m up-leg (low of 3 h -> high since), leg >= 1.5 ATR

in_fvg_5m.definition: entry inside an unfilled bullish 5m FVG formed in the last 2 h (+-0.1 ATR)

fvg_1h_leg.definition: a bullish 5m FVG >= 0.25 ATR formed in the last hour (displacement left a gap)

ifvg_5m.definition: a bearish 5m FVG (last 3 h) was inverted by a close above its top in the last hour

in_ob_5m.definition: entry inside a bullish order block: last down candle before a >=1 ATR up body, unbroken, last 3 h

in_breaker_5m.definition: entry inside a bullish breaker: up candle at a swing high, lower low taken, then close above that high

in_mitig_5m.definition: entry inside a bullish mitigation block: as breaker but the dip made a higher low

rejection_wick.definition: the lowest bar of the last 30 min has a lower wick >= 50% of its range

in_rejection_blk.definition: entry inside the wick zone (low .. body bottom) of a long-wick swing low of the last 2 h

in_bpr_5m.definition: entry inside a balanced price range (bearish FVG overlapped by a later bullish FVG, last 2 h)

vol_imb_5m.definition: a bullish volume imbalance (body gap between two up candles) in the last 30 min

liq_void_draw.definition: an unfilled bearish liquidity void (>= 2 ATR candle, last 6 h) above the entry (draw)

mss_disp.definition: close above the last 5m swing high in the last hour with displacement (>=0.8 ATR body or FVG)

choch_5m.definition: 5m change of character: close above a swing high that was a lower high, in the last hour

trend_5m_with.definition: the last 5m break of structure was upward

trend_15m_with.definition: 15m BOS trend up (last close through a confirmed 15m swing was upward)

trend_1h_with.definition: 1H BOS trend up (last close through a confirmed 1H swing was upward)

daily_bias_with.definition: ICT daily bias up: prior day closed above the day before's high, or swept its low and closed back in

erl_swept.definition: external sell-side liquidity (PDL / PWL / Asia low / London low, untaken earlier) swept in the last 3 h

erl_to_irl.definition: erl_swept and the entry is inside a bullish 5m FVG (ERL -> IRL entry)

inducement.definition: a confirmed 5m swing low inside the down-leg was taken before the final low (staircase/IDM)

cisd.definition: CISD: a close above the open of the down-candle run that printed the last-hour low

in_sb_hour.definition: entry inside a Silver Bullet hour (03-04, 10-11, 14-15 ET)

kz_ny_am.definition: entry inside the NY AM killzone 08:30-11:00

kz_ny_pm.definition: entry inside the NY PM killzone 13:30-16:00

first_hour_rth.definition: entry in the first RTH hour 09:30-10:30

qt_ny_q3.definition: Quarterly Theory: entry in Q3 (09:00-10:30) of the NY AM session 06:00-12:00

qt_micro_23.definition: Quarterly Theory: entry in the 2nd or 3rd 22.5-min quarter of its 90-min cycle

below_mo.definition: entry below the 00:00 ET midnight open (after midnight)

below_globex_open.definition: entry below the 18:00 ET daily (Globex) open

below_tso.definition: entry below the Quarterly-Theory true session open (open of Q2 of the 6-h session)

nwog_draw.definition: the NWOG consequent encroachment (Fri close / Sun open midpoint) is above the entry

in_nwog.definition: entry inside the NWOG range (+-0.1 ATR)

ndog_draw.definition: the NDOG midpoint (17:00 close / 18:00 open) is above the entry

judas_mo.definition: Judas: after midnight price ran >= 0.1 ADR below the midnight open, entry back above it

judas_rth.definition: Judas: after 09:30 price ran >= 0.1 ADR below the RTH open, entry (>= 09:45) back above it

po3_daily.definition: daily PO3: today's low so far >= 0.15 ADR below the 18:00 open and entry <= open + 0.15 ADR

wk_profile_early.definition: Mon-Wed and entry in the bottom 30% of the week's range so far (low of week forming early)

cbdr_ext.definition: today's low (since 20:00) is 1-4 CBDR standard deviations below the CBDR (14:00-20:00) low

asia_ext.definition: today's low since 00:00 is 2-4 Asia-range SDs below the Asia (20:00-00:00) low

asia_small.definition: the Asia range is <= 40% of the 20-day ADR (accumulation)

vwap_2sd_fade.definition: entry below session VWAP - 2 SD (stretched; mean reversion long)

vwap_1sd_inside.definition: entry within +-1 SD of session VWAP

in_prior_value.definition: entry inside the prior RTH value area (VAL..VAH, 70%)

poc_side_with.definition: entry above the prior RTH POC

open_in_value.definition: 09:30 open inside the prior value area (balance)

open_out_value_with.definition: 09:30 open above the prior VAH (imbalance up)

ib_break_with.definition: after 10:30, a close above the initial-balance high happened before the entry

orb_with.definition: after 10:00, entry above the 30-min opening-range high

in_or.definition: after 10:00, entry inside the 30-min opening range

at_lvn.definition: entry at a low-volume node of the prior 5 sessions' profile (< 0.5x median bin)

at_hvn.definition: entry at a high-volume node of the prior 5 sessions' profile (> 1.5x median bin)

round_big.definition: the last-30-min low is within 0.15 ATR of a 100-pt NQ level (50-pt ES), unadjusted price

round_q.definition: the last-30-min low is within 0.15 ATR of a 00/25/50/75 level, unadjusted price

pdl_swept.definition: prior-day low swept (traded through, untaken earlier today) in the last hour

pwl_swept.definition: prior-week low swept in the last hour

in_pw_range.definition: entry inside the prior week's range

news_day.definition: a high-impact US release today (CPI, NFP, FOMC; data/news/events.csv)

adr_room.definition: at least 50% of the 20-day ADR left above the entry (low so far + ADR - entry >= 0.5 ADR)

adr_exhausted.definition: today's range so far >= 100% of the 20-day ADR

atr_expanding.definition: mean 5m true range of the last 30 min >= 1.3x its 10-day same-time average

nr4_prev.definition: prior day was an NR4 (narrowest range of the last 4 sessions)

trend_day_with.definition: trend day up so far: >= 0.4 ADR above the 18:00 open and in the top 25% of today's range

trend_day_against.definition: trend day down so far (the mirror), i.e. trading against a trend day

gap_big.definition: RTH gap (09:30 open vs prior 16:00 close) >= 0.25 ADR

gap_with.definition: RTH gap up >= 0.1 ADR (gap in the trade's direction)

gap_against.definition: RTH gap down >= 0.1 ADR (fading / against the gap)

nq_rs_with.definition: NQ stronger than ES since the 09:30 open (18:00 before RTH): long the stronger index

es_vwap_with.definition: ES above its own session VWAP

smt_es.definition: SMT: exactly one of NQ / ES swept its 4-h low in the last 30 min (divergence)

es_confirms.definition: both NQ and ES swept their 4-h lows in the last 30 min (no divergence)
